recommended_course_spring_title: Spring Culture Trip — Tradition, Crafts & Bookstores
recommended_course_spring_desc: A spring course connecting Jeonju Hanok Village's traditional liquor and crafts, Seoul's back-alley indie bookstores, and Andong's Confucian culture
recommended_course_summer_title: Summer Culture Trip — Sea, Cafés & Food
recommended_course_summer_desc: A summer culture course tracing Gangneung's coffee aroma, Tongyeong's southern coast cuisine, and Mokpo's modern alleyways
recommended_course_autumn_title: Autumn Culture Trip — Literature, Art & Galleries
recommended_course_autumn_desc: An autumn course running from a Seoul art museum pilgrimage through a Gangneung literary journey to Hadong's tea-field workshops
recommended_course_winter_title: Winter Culture Trip — Film, Modern Heritage & Cafés
recommended_course_winter_desc: A winter course wrapping up with the mood of Chuncheon's film city, the history of Gunsan's modern alleyways, and Gangneung's coffee aroma
